Name: (CP) (PIF) Charri's Basic Doors
Author: charri67
Description:
I wanted doors that fit with my house decor, then started drawing designs, and the next thing I knew I had over fifty door sprites I had to program into my game... 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I recommend using [url=https://github.com/Floogen/Stardrop][b]Stardrop Mod Manager[/b][/url][b] [/b]for installation. With Stardrop, you can drag and drop the .zip file, then enable it and get to playing. The .zip contains an i18n file if you want to change the door names.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]To install manually, follow the instructions listed [url=https://www.stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]here[/url].[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Adds 56 doors to both the Furniture Catalogue and the PIF door merchant in the train tunnel. Doors are 100 gold each.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Requires [/b][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][color=#D4D4D8][b]Content Patcher[/b][/color][/url]. Does not require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF[/url], but was made with PIF functionality in mind. 

Not required, but suggested: I also recommend installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] for easy decoration, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture [/url]to move the doors into place as you like, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27226]Wall Decorations [/url]for layering wall decor on top of the doors.

[line]
Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Sharogg/mods]Sharogg[/url], whose [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28537]Door Mania [/url]I referenced while I figured out how to build the code, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/orangeblossom7/mods]Orangeblossom7[/url], whose basic and earthy furniture's color schemes I used for some of the doors.
